name: ErrorResult

fields.name: message
fields.documentation: The error message returned from the Fluxzero Runtime or client logic.

fields.name: modelHistoryUnavailable
fields.documentation:
Optional evidence that a requested historical Model head cannot be reconstructed. Older peers ignore this
 additive field and retain the ordinary error message; absence must not be inferred from that message.

fields.name: requestId
fields.documentation: ID correlating this result with its originating request.

fields.name: timestamp
fields.documentation: Time at which the error occurred.

constructors.name: ErrorResult
constructors.documentation: Creates an ordinary unstructured request failure.

constructors.name: ErrorResult
constructors.documentation: Creates a failure with optional, typed historical-read evidence.
